messages:
sam: heads up — CI is red on my serve-rt branch after I rebased onto main. failing on GPU kernel compile in shard 14, not sure why. anyone available to help triage?
ci-bot: [CI] Build failed: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/45231 (shard 14) — nvcc link error in //serve/runtime:kernel_test :x
maya: @sam can you paste the top of the log? nvcc errors usually show the missing symbol or arch mismatch near the top. :eyes:
sam: here — pasted the error snippet: ```nvcc fatal : Unsupported gpu architecture 'compute_80' when trying to compile for sm_80```
sam: i rebased onto main at commit abcde1234 and pushed. local `bazel test //serve/...` passes on my machine (RTX 3090, driver 525.x). CI runners are SM 80 (A100).
eli: hmm, that error often means our toolchain flags changed on main. try setting `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST` or check the docker image used by CI. did main recently bump the base image?
zoe: i noticed a Dockerfile change in main that updated CUDA to 12.1 in commit f12b9 — CI images rebuilt this morning. could be a mismatch with `nvcc`/cuda toolkit we build against.
maya: quick check: can you repro in a container matching CI? `docker run -it --rm redwood/ci:cuda12.1 /bin/bash` then `bazel test //serve/...`. if it reproduces, bisect main for the image/toolchain change.
sam: i don't have CI image locally. can someone rerun shard 14 with verbose logs? or grant me access to the runner image?
ci-bot: Rerun requested by sam for run 45231, shard 14 — queued.
eli: if rerun still fails, do a `git bisect` between abcde1234 and main to find the commit that introduced the compile flags change. you can script `nvcc --version` check in bisect run.
zoe: also check `build_defs/cc_toolchain` — we recently added `-gencode=arch=compute_80,code=sm_80` conditional on cuda version; maybe the condition evaluates differently in CI.
maya: another workaround if it's blocker: pin the branch to use older CI image temporarily (`image: redwood/ci:cuda12.0`) in the PR, then we can buy time to fix the toolchain detection.
sam: thanks — ci-bot rerun came back (still failing). attaching full log (snippet): ```/usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc: error: unrecognized command line option '--extended-lambda'```
eli: that is a clang/nvcc interop flag — suggests the host compiler in CI changed. check `/usr/bin/clang++ --version` in the image.
zoe: i'll SSH into the failed runner and dump the env + compiler versions, posting back in 10m. :thumbsup:
maya: if you want, i can open a quick PR to pin image on your branch; will help unblock other changes.
sam: please do that, @maya — i'll also try `git bisect` locally using a dockerized step. appreciate the help.
zoe: update: runner shows clang 16, cuda toolkit 12.1, nvcc 12.1 — main introduced a change to the build container earlier today. i filed a tiny revert PR for the image bump (will link).
eli: if revert lands, we should be able to merge your branch after rebase. if not, we'll need to make the build flags robust for both toolchain combos.
sam: cool — i'll wait for the revert then rebase and re-run CI. thanks everyone! :pray:
